audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0/1/2].side were all 'Skill' while content win[0/1/2] and packet.levelChart both said 'Zyra'; phases[4/5/6].side were 'Skill' while win[4/5/6]/packet said 'Hwei'. Row 3 (Skill/Skill) already agreed.
audit.why: Zyra's E-Q plant combo out-bursts Hwei's slow-forming spells early and her seeds add sustained DPS through level 3; Hwei's R and item burst punish her telegraphed, committed Stranglethorns and her lack of an escape from 6 onward — content and packet already reflect this.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Grasping Roots but had no digit (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad copy-paste (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED) instead of describing Zyra's plants, which tick DPS independent of her own cooldowns and can spawn on any seed underfoot — an interaction never stated on the page.
audit.why: Grasping Roots (E) is a flat 11s cooldown; her plants (grown from Deadly Spines/Grasping Roots cast near a seed) deal ongoing damage separate from her own spell rotation, so clearing the nearest plant before trading and checking the ground for seeds both matter mechanically.
audit.corrected: Added the real E cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns, and rewrote dosFull[1].d/dontsFull[2].d to state the plant-DPS and seed interactions instead of pasted trade lines.
